name: pigsgottafly
description: Pig's Gotta Fly: a personal VFR flight planner for the Athinai FIR (LGGG)

scripts.typecheck: node node_modules/typescript7/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && node node_modules/typescript7/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run lint:swift && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.native:build: cd native/ios && xcodegen && xcodebuild -project PigsGottaFly.xcodeproj -scheme PigsGottaFly -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' -derivedDataPath build test
scripts.ios:upload: npm run ios:version && cd native/ios && xcodegen && xcodebuild -project PigsGottaFly.xcodeproj -scheme PigsGottaFly -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -archivePath build/PigsGottaFly.xcarchive -allowProvisioningUpdates archive && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath build/PigsGottaFly.xcarchive -exportOptionsPlist ExportOptions.plist -exportPath build/export -authenticationKeyPath ~/.appstoreconnect/private_keys/AuthKey_QQGZKKK8L2.p8 -authenticationKeyID QQGZKKK8L2 -authenticationKeyIssuerID eb5e4f62-0a04-4cb2-9dda-da27a99dbd0a
scripts.lint:swift: xcrun swift-format lint --strict --configuration .swift-format --recursive native/ios/PigsGottaFly native/ios/PigsGottaFlyTests native/ios/PigsGottaFlyUITests
scripts.format:swift: xcrun swift-format format --in-place --configuration .swift-format --recursive native/ios/PigsGottaFly native/ios/PigsGottaFlyTests native/ios/PigsGottaFlyUITests
